en.headline: Leslie Cheung exhibition adds free film screenings in Sha Tin
en.dek: Hong Kong Heritage Museum’s 70th-birthday show, already open with more than 300 objects, began a free film series on Saturday that runs into next April.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department’s Hong Kong Heritage Museum is staging Continue to Love — Leslie Cheung 70th Birthday Memorial Exhibition on the first floor, in Thematic Gallery 5. The museum said the display is free and runs until 10 May 2027. It opened on 9 September, three days before what would have been the singer and actor’s 70th birthday.

The museum said the show brings together more than 300 items, including records, concert costumes, film posters and stills, awards and popular-culture objects. Eleven stage outfits are on view, among them clothing from the Crossing 97 concert and the 2000 Hot Passion tour. A section of Cheung’s former home has been recreated for the first time, using furniture he used, the museum said. The exhibition is curated by Chan Suk-fan, with support from the official fan club.

A companion film series started on Saturday and is scheduled through 3 April 2027 in the first-floor theatre. The museum listed six titles: For Your Heart Only, A Better Tomorrow, A Chinese Ghost Story, Rouge, Behind the Yellow Line and He’s a Woman, She’s a Man. Tickets are free. The museum said they are given out from noon on the screening day at the first floor, one per person, while stocks last. The theatre opens 15 minutes before each showing.
The museum is open from 10am to 7pm. It said crowd control, including timed tickets if needed, may be used, and daily exhibition leaflets are limited to one per person.

zh.headline: 文化博物館張國榮紀念展加推免費電影放映
zh.dek: 康文署香港文化博物館「繼續寵愛・張國榮70誕辰・紀念展」展出逾300件展品，周六起在館內劇院免費放映六部電影，至明年4月。
body: 康樂及文化事務署香港文化博物館正在一樓專題展覽館五舉辦「繼續寵愛・張國榮70誕辰・紀念展」。博物館表示展覽免費入場，展期至2027年5月10日，已於9月9日開幕，正值張國榮70歲誕辰前夕。
館方指展覽匯集逾300件展品，包括唱片、舞台服飾、電影海報與劇照、獎項及流行文化產物，當中有11套演唱會服裝，包括《跨越97》及2000年《熱・情演唱會》的服飾。展覽並首次重置其舊居部分場景，展出他曾使用的家具。展覽由陳淑芬策劃，並獲「哥」迷會支持。
配合展覽的電影放映系列已於周六展開，至2027年4月3日在一樓劇院舉行。館方列出六部作品，包括《為你鍾情》、《英雄本色》、《倚女幽魂》、《脂脂扣》、《緣份》及《金枝玉葉》。入場免費，門票於放映當日中午12時在一樓派發，每人限取一張，派完即止，劇院於開場前15分鐘開放。
博物館今日開放時間為上午10時至下午7時。館方表示會按人流實施管理，必要時或會派籌分時段入場，展覽單張每日限量，每人限取一張。
